Check city-wise list Customers should check the RBI holiday list before visiting a bank. On 21 October, closures apply in eight cities while many others remain open.  Sounak Mukhopadhyay Published 21 Oct 2026, 06:48 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Bank holiday today: Are banks like SBI, HDFC and ICICI closed on 21 October? Check city-wise list ( AI image ) AI Quick Read Banks are not closed everywhere around the country on 21 October. The Reserve Bank of India's holiday list shows closures in only some cities. The day is marked for Vijaya Dasami, Durga Puja (Dasain) and Maha Dashami. Banks, such as SBI , HDFC and ICICI , are closed in eight cities on this day, including Agartala, Bengaluru, Gangtok and Guwahati. Kochi, Kolkata, Shillong and Thiruvananthapuram also have a holiday today. RBI marks each of these as a holiday under the Negotiable Instruments Act. Also Read | SBI, PNB and 4 banks revise lending rates: Will your home loan EMI increase? Banks stay open in the other cities on the RBI list. These include Mumbai, New Delhi, Chennai and Hyderabad. Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Jaipur, Lucknow and Patna are also open. All these cities had their Dussehra holiday on 20 October. Customers in these cities can visit branches as usual. Please check your city before you go to a branch. On 20 October, banks were closed in most cities on the list. Only Gangtok and Imphal were not marked. This day was for Dussehra, Maha Navami, Ayudha Pooja and Durga Puja. Banks were closed in cities such as Bengaluru, Guwahati, Kochi, Kolkata, Shillong and Thiruvananthapuram on 20 October as well. In fact, Thiruvananthapuram, Kolkata, Kochi and Guwahati also had their banks closed on 19 October. Also Read | RD interest rates: How much can you really earn? What post offices, banks offer Are banks closed for the rest of the week? The RBI list shows a few holidays for the rest of this week. Thursday, 22 October, is a holiday only in Gangtok. The occasion is Durga Puja (Dasain). Banks in all other listed cities stay open. Friday, 23 October, is also a holiday only in Gangtok. It is again for Durga Puja (Dasain). Branches in other cities should work normally. Also Read | FD rates for senior citizens in October: Interest reaches 8.50% in these banks Saturday, 24 October, is different. The RBI notes that all scheduled and non-scheduled banks observe a public holiday on the second and fourth Saturdays. The 24th is the fourth Saturday of October. So banks will be closed across the country on that day. Then, 25 October will be off as well since it’s a Sunday.. A look at next week Monday, 26 October, brings another round of closures. The occasion is Laxmi Puja, Accession Day and Maharishi Valmiki's Birthday. Banks will be closed in Agartala, Bengaluru, Chandigarh and Jammu. Shimla and Srinagar will also be closed. Holidays differ from city to city. So customers should check the RBI list for their own city. Plan any branch visit for cash deposits, cheque clearing or document work before the holiday.
